namespace = v

# The first vanilla event.
v.1 = {
	type = character_event
	title = v.1.t
	desc = v.1.desc
	theme = seduction
	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
		exists = scope:target
		faith = faith:catholic
		exists = title:k_x
		exists = title:c_x
		has_trait = brave
	}
	immediate = {
		add_gold = 5
		set_variable = { name = seen value = 1 }
		save_scope_as = target
		trigger_event = v.2
		every_vassal = { add_gold = 1 }
		capital_county = { add_title_law = x }
		random_list = {
			90 = { trigger_event = v.2 }
			10 = { add_gold = 1 }
		}
		v_effect = { AMOUNT = 5 }
		add_character_flag = seen_one
		send_interface_toast = {
			type = event_toast
			title = v.1.toast
			message_filter_type = custom
			add_gold = 1
		}
		send_interface_toast = { title = { first_valid = { triggered_desc = { trigger = { is_adult = yes } desc = v.1.toast_first } } } }
		send_interface_toast = { title = { first_valid = { desc = v.1.toast_first } } }
		add_opinion = {
			modifier = v_opinion_1
			target = root
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = v.1.a
		trigger = { is_adult = yes }
		trigger_event = v.2
		add_gold = 1
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
	after = { add_gold = 1 }
	cooldown = { days = 10 }
}

v.2 = {
	type = character_event
	title = v.2.t
	triggered_desc = {
		desc = v.2.d
		trigger = { is_adult = yes }
	}
	option = { name = v.2.a }
	cooldown = { months = 2 }
}
